summary: Foresight Autonomous Holdings filed a 6-K furnishing a November 2, 2026 press release reminding holders of its voluntary delisting of ordinary shares from the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange, first announced September 30, 2026. Last TASE trading day is January 1, 2027, with delisting effective January 4, 2027; ADSs (each representing 90 ordinary shares) continue on Nasdaq under FRSX. Depositary BNY Mellon waives ADS issuance fees through January 7, 2027, then charges $5.00 per 100 ADSs. No board recommendation or advisor is named; the release is a procedural conversion reminder, not a special-situation trade. Watch conversion deadlines and any post-delisting liquidity shift to Nasdaq.
